message.description: Message to display, if any, as a result of the action

skipBanner.description: Whether or not to display a banner as a result of the action

actionGenerator.description:
Actions to dispatch on action result.
If the lambda argument `isError` is true, the `response` object is the Error.

criteria.description:
Criteria to follow this result path. When not specified, any call that
does not error is considered a success.

closeModal.description: Whether or not to close the modal on the result
